title: My favorite version of the #dvdasa theme song featuring cat man#mangchi
summary: A roughly 1:34 performed DVDASA mothership theme with two conflicting local transcript editions. The aligned record accepts the program/mothership opening, science-fiction imagery, Andromeda, telescopes, forest/camping/moon-eclipse sequence, beam-me-up/Scotty, humanoids/profit, Andromedans/love, humans-are-unkind, mankind/Earth, facade/squad, intelligence/pods, repeated people-I-want-to-be-with refrain and outro. It explicitly withholds at least ten rhyme-dense phrases where primary captions and Whisper disagree. Masks and repeated song structure remain; no clean lyric, profanity expansion, Cat Man/Mangchi performer, songwriter, character canon or voice is invented.
